snippet.title: TEAM HOGUS
snippet.description:
TEAM HOGUS. (Watch in 1080p if possible!)



Team Hogus is a WarioWare-inspired game which runs through a series of microgames in two different game modes.

Play in the main story mode and you'll be put through them in a pre-determined order, with elaborate boss minigames every now and then.
After you beat the story, give random mode a try, wherein the mcirogames are played in a random order and get increasingly harder. Try for a high score!

Find out more here: https://happy-frog-games.itch.io/team-hogus

(For those who want the full name, it's "Team Hogus: GHAMEMFAIFTH OTHIYLTIM: Generic Hyper Action Movie Extravaganza Minigame Festival Alien Invasion Force Team Hogus, Or Team Hogus If You Like That Instead More".)
